AboutPage.meta_title: About Us - Life Science Bio-Computing Infrastructure & GneroAI Platform | GeneTind
AboutPage.meta_description: GeneTind is dedicated to the deep convergence of life sciences and advanced computing, delivering HPC heterogeneous computing, GneroAI bio-foundation platforms, and all-in-one appliances for multi-omics research.
AboutPage.hero_badge: 🧬 Life Science IT · Bio-Computing Infrastructure & AI Services
AboutPage.hero_subtitle: Using evolutionary biology as our blueprint, driven by supercomputing and biological foundation models to support life science research and translation.
AboutPage.hero_narrative: GeneTind is a technology enterprise dedicated to life science IT data services and bio-computing infrastructure. With sustained investment across multi-omics throughput, GPU topology-aware scheduling, biological graph neural networks, and macromolecular simulations, we have established an end-to-end technical solution spanning sequencing ingestion, heterogeneous compute, biological models, and pipeline delivery.
AboutPage.pillars_title: Fortifying Compute & Model Foundations for the Bio-Computing Era
AboutPage.pillars_desc: From low-level hardware acceleration to intelligent analysis models, we deliver turnkey computing solutions for research institutes, medical centers, and biopharma enterprises.
AboutPage.pillar1_desc: Fusing multi-omics graph neural networks, structural biological inference (AlphaFold3 / ESMFold), and automated bioinformatic agents. Assisting researchers in orchestrating complex workflows interactively, supporting hypothesis testing and automated report generation.
AboutPage.pillar2_desc: Engineered for high concurrency and burst bio-compute demands, featuring a proprietary Slurm / Kubernetes hybrid scheduling kernel. Synergized with cold-plate liquid cooling and 400G InfiniBand fabrics, boosting GPU utilization above 94%.
AboutPage.pillar3_title: Turnkey Bio-Computing Workstations & LIMS Quality Standard
AboutPage.pillar3_desc: Bridging core and edge environments for laboratory plug-and-play private deployment. Certified against ISO 15189 and ISO 17025 quality frameworks, guaranteeing zero data leakage, auditability, and regulatory compliance.
AboutPage.timeline_desc: Since our founding, GeneTind has focused on the intersection of life sciences and information technology, continuously enhancing the efficiency and reliability of biological computing systems.
AboutPage.timeline1_desc: GeneTind was established. Tackling high-throughput sequencing IO scenarios, we engineered TeraFS parallel storage, achieving 100+ GB/s throughput verification.
AboutPage.timeline2_desc: Officially launched our specialized Bio-LIMS for multi-omics laboratories. Aligned with ISO 15189 and ISO 17025 standards, enabling end-to-end traceability and audit logging from sample accessioning and sequencing to bioinformatic data delivery.
AboutPage.timeline3_desc: Unveiled GneroAI life-science computing platform, integrating macromolecular structure inference and automated bioinformatic workflow orchestration for complex omics scenarios.
AboutPage.timeline4_title: Coordinated Fabric · Distributed Bio-Computing & Multi-Center Collaboration
AboutPage.timeline4_desc: Advancing seamless coordination between edge appliances and central HPC clusters to support multi-center collaborative research and high-concurrency omics data analysis, empowering biomedical innovation.
AboutPage.values_desc: Navigating between the microscopic intricacies of biology and the macroscopic systems of HPC, four core tenets guide our technical decisions.
AboutPage.val1_desc: Prioritizing computing energy efficiency. We implement cold-plate liquid cooling and dynamic orchestration, effectively reducing data center power consumption.
AboutPage.val2_desc: Genomic and research data require strict confidentiality. Our private on-premise architectures ensure core scientific data remains securely within the laboratory environment.
AboutPage.val3_desc: From low-level parallel file systems and scheduling kernels to high-level biological analysis workflows, we insist on independent research and industrial long-term stress-testing.
AboutPage.val4_desc: Driven by real-world biological and pharmaceutical workflow bottlenecks, ensuring every compute resource translates into genuine research and clinical insights.
AboutPage.cta_title: Partner with GeneTind to Unlock Your Biological Data
AboutPage.cta_desc: Whether architecting a high-throughput bioinformatics HPC cluster or deploying an on-premise GneroAI appliance, our systems architects and bioinformatics engineers are ready to assist.
